title: A short way to stability
abstract: arXiv:2511.16104v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The paper presents a concise and straightforward approach way to obtain the basic facts about stable contract systems in bilateral markets: existence, polariza- tion, and lattice structure. The primary tool employed is the notion of desirability operator. This notion is essentially equivalent to the concept of Plott choice function, but it allows for a clearer visualization of stable systems of contracts as fixed points of some operator. The existence and other properties of these fixed points is obtained using Knaster-Tarski fixed-point theorem. Additionally, we explore related topics such as order structure of the set of stable contract systems, the polarization of the interests of the parties, the constructiveness of the approach, its application to comparative statics, a relaxation of bipartition assumption, as well as generalization to systems where contracts can be established with varying intensities instead of being either ac

translated_title: 通往稳定性的简短路径
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种简洁而直接的方法，用于获取双边市场中稳定契约系统的基本事实：存在性、两极分化以及格结构。所采用的主要工具是“合意性算子”这一概念。该概念本质上等价于普洛特选择函数，但它能够更清晰地将稳定契约系统形象化为某个算子的不动点。这些不动点的存在性及其他性质则借助克纳斯特-塔斯基不动点定理得到。此外，我们还探讨了若干相关主题，例如稳定契约系统集合的序结构、各方利益的两极分化、该方法的建设性、其在比较静态学中的应用、对二部划分假设的放松，以及向契约可以以不同强度建立（而非仅有“成立与否”两种状态）的系统的推广。
tldr: 本文提出以“合意性算子”为核心工具，并借助克纳斯特-塔斯基不动点定理，简洁地刻画了双边市场中稳定契约系统的存在性、格结构及各方利益两极分化等基本性质。
en_tdlr: This paper offers a concise route to the basic properties of stable contract systems in bilateral markets—existence, lattice structure, and polarization—by using the notion of a desirability operator together with the Knaster-Tarski fixed-point theorem.
